purpose: Published age norms used only as priors for a baby's first weeks of tracking and as a fallback when a baby has too few logged events. Never a verdict: the app never tells a family that a baby is above, below or outside a norm. See docs/design/28-age-norms.md.
ageConvention: Age in completed days since birth (birth day = day 0); fromDays inclusive, toDays exclusive. Months to days: 30.4375 days a month, halves rounded up (1 m = 30, 2 m = 61, 3 m = 91, 4 m = 122, 6 m = 183, 8 m = 244, 12 m = 365, 18 m = 548, 24 m = 731, 36 m = 1096). fromWeeks/toWeeks = days / 7, two decimals. Day of life N (as in 'day 1-2') is age N-1 days.
mergeRule: low = the smallest evidence low or evidence typical, high = the largest evidence high or evidence typical (the wider range wins and contains every published central value); low is null when no evidence gives a low, high is null when none gives a high. typical = the typical of the evidence from typicalSourceId (Brazilian source first, then systematic review or meta-analysis, then other studies, then guidance statements); null when no source gives a central value.
